results.description:
Have you ever struggled to find confidence on stage or inspiration in the studio? AeroPads cues immersive pads and soundscapes that inspire and equip you to perform and write your best.

ENHANCE YOUR SOUND. ENGAGE YOUR AUDIENCE.
Every musician has experienced an empty mix or an awkward transition. When using AeroPads, you instantly add more dimension and character to your sound. With a more immersive mix and the ability to perform smooth and seamless transitions, you will feel more confident while your audience will be more engaged.

FOR EVERY MUSICIAN.
Pads and soundscapes are a versatile accompaniment to nearly any style of music. Whether you are a soloist or full band, AeroPads will take your sound to the next level. Rock bands, worship teams, wedding singers, producers, songwriters, and instrumentalists are just a few of the many types of musicians that have loved using AeroPads.

DESIGNED FOR THE STAGE. INSPIRED BY SPACE.
AeroPads features creative and immersive soundscapes paired with a beautiful and intuitive interface, all inspired by the pinnacle of exploration and inspiration: outer space.

CREATIVITY THAT SPARKS CREATIVITY.
AeroPads aren't your typical pads. Most pads out there are really boring or insanely obnoxious. However, AeroPads features thoughtfully crafted soundscapes that are meticulously fine-tuned with the perfect amount of harmonic and textural movement. Simply put, AeroPads won't step on the toes of your arrangement or get on the nerves of your sound guy (like most other pads out there).


Highlighted Features:
- A beautiful space-inspired interface with a simple and intuitive design.
- Live View: Every key and three of your favorite patches are instantly accessible (best suited for experimentation, free-flowing sets, and songwriting).
- Setlist View: Plan and build a detailed setlist (best suited for structured sets and seamless transitions).
- The iconic Atmosphere Soundpack which includes five unique patches named after and inspired by the layers of Earth's atmosphere. 
- Three patches can be added to Live View to be made instantly accessible, so there's no need to dig through menus to just to change a patch when performing live.
- Additional patches and Soundpacks available for purchase.
- Key-specific pads in multiple tonalities: major, minor, and neutral.
- Concert pitch adjustment.


How to Use:
01. Cue a pad that matches the key of your musical arrangement.
02. Play overtop of the accompanying pads and soundcapes.
03. Enjoy the boost of audience engagement, musician confidence, and creative inspiration.

Pads and soundscapes are intended as a subtle accompaniment to musical arrangements/performances. They are designed to be cued according to the key of the arrangement. Once cued, you'll hear a droning pad centered around the root note with additional harmonic textures within the selected key. The only time a pad's key should change within a song is in the instance of a key change. For best results, mix AeroPads appropriately within the overall mix. When mixed too loud, AeroPads may compete with melodies and the arrangement. When mixed too quietly, AeroPads may be less effective. When mixed appropriately, they will sound awesome.

results.description:
Designed by a musician, AeroPads offers professional and inspiring ambient pads. Elevate your live sound with immersive pads and keep your team locked in time with precise metronome clicks.

Trusted by professional musicians– from small stages to sold-out stadiums– AeroPads are the best-sounding pads on the market, widely praised for being harmonically intricate and versatile without sounding boring or stagnant.

Ambient pads add depth and dimension to revitalize your mix and eliminate dead space and awkward transitions. 

AeroPads is a space-inspired ambient pad player designed to accompany and underscore live musical performances of many kinds.

Operation is simple:
1. Select a Key.
2. Select a Patch.
3. Play.

AeroPads is widely used for weddings, cinematic scores, worship services, songwriting sessions, rehearsals, open mics, studio tracks, and chill ambient arrangements.

Ambient pads are often used with acoustic guitar, electric guitar, and piano, but are equally compatible with instruments such as violin, cello, synthesizers, ukulele, harp, and more.

AeroPads feature enough harmonic movement and texture to fill out solo performances while remaining restrained enough to accompany full bands.

Ambient pads can help you feel more relaxed and prepared on stage, so you can focus on the performance.

Designed by Aerospace Audio, AeroPads feature the same sounds and similar features that power the iconic foot-controlled instrument: Atmosphere.

Highlighted Features:
∙ Expressive ambient pads in all 12 keys and 3 common tonalities: Major, Minor, and Neutral.
∙ Smooth, adjustable crossfades for seamless transitions.
∙ Built-in metronome clicks with visual and audible cues to keep you in time– and a panic button to ditch the click if your team drifts tempo or skips a beat.
∙ Customizable Patch Slots and Patch Pages so that your favorite presets are always within reach.
∙ Programmable setlists recall each song’s pad selection, key, tonality, tempo, time signature, click sound, and individual level settings.
∙ Independent overall, pad, and click levels and presets provide precise control for rehearsals, recording, and live performance.
∙ Adjustable concert pitch tuning for a variety of reference pitches, including 440 Hz, 432 Hz, 444 Hz, 442 Hz, and more.
∙ AirPlay support.
∙ Independent pad and click routing send pads to the speakers and clicks to in-ear monitors.
∙ Expandable sound library with additional sound packs available for purchase.
∙ Mono, stereo, and split-channel routing options.
∙ Optimized for both iPhone and iPad.

Note from Isaac, the designer:
"I hope you enjoy using AeroPads as much as I do. I designed AeroPads because most of the available pad players and ambient pads that I tried felt boring and uninspiring. Don’t get me wrong, there’s definitely some cool stuff out there, but I never fell in love with any of it. The apps that I tried were honestly a bit clunky and confusing. And most of the ambient pads that I heard were either repetitive, boring, or just wildly distracting.

When I was looking for an ambient pad player, I wanted the interface to inspire me the second I launched the app. I wanted to get lost and feel immersed in the sound the moment an ambient pad cues. I wanted every action to be intuitive and simple. I wanted a tool that pushed me to be more creative, not bore and confuse me. I never found a tool that checked all those boxes, so I decided to create my own.

As a musician who has struggled with self-esteem and confidence, AeroPads gave me the confidence I needed to perform more comfortably and professionally. When I use AeroPads live on stage, I immediately feel more relaxed and prepared. When I use AeroPads as a starting primer to compose and write songs, I immediately feel more inspired and creative.
If you’re a musician who loves to try new inspiring tools, I hope you love trying AeroPads.

Isaac
Aerospace Audio

ps. Troposphere and Satellite are my favorite patches."
